insight: Founded in 2019 by eight alumni of ad-tech firm BrightRoll (sold to Yahoo for ~$640M), led by BrightRoll's former CEO.
name: Pipedream
tagline: Connect APIs, AI, and databases with code-level workflows.
description: A workflow automation platform where steps are pre-built triggers/actions or arbitrary Node.js and Python code, glued across 3,000+ managed app integrations with hosted auth. Pipedream Connect embeds those integrations into your own product or AI agent, and the catalog is exposed MCP-natively so agents can call any connector as a tool.
edge: Drop real Node.js or Python into any step over 3,000+ managed integrations — code-level control where Zapier and Make stay no-code.
pros: Connect embeds integrations in your app
cons: Code steps mean a developer audience
